In Story, follow eight stories in order. Capitals are flexible; include punctuation. Words deals 50 lowercase words at a time from Monkeytype’s English 200, without punctuation. Finish either line to advance without a fall.

Type one word, then press Space or Enter. Backspace corrects it before submission. During play, Tab restarts the session immediately. A matching prefix moves the runner; a wrong submission can trip him.

Minimum accuracy gives you five active seconds from your first keystroke on each line. After that, even a partial word below the minimum causes a fall. The exact minimum is safe. At 100% there’s no grace; at 0% there are no accuracy falls.

Consecutive mistakes counts submissions instead. Three wrong in a row cause a fall. A correct word or a new line clears the count.

Type again at landing to get up faster. Only correct submissions count toward WPM. Pause and airborne time don’t count. After ten correct words your speed can set a local best.
